summary.intent: Prepare the 0.20.0 release of callisto by turning several delegated subagent workstreams (JSON contract audit, error-code reach, stability contract tests, scale/perf hotspots) into verified, signed, pushed branches and PRs with proper descriptions.
summary.outcome: Branches for JSON contract (#505), error codes (#506), stability contract tests (#504) were committed, signed, pushed, linked to trail #198 and given PR bodies; the perf-scale branch was reviewed, adjusted (older git flag, changeset added), verified and pushed as perf/scale-hotspots. Reviews, E165 help change approval, and release PR #493 remain pending.

repo: Every `--format json` success output already carries `schemaVersion`; `release inspect` prints raw intent/manifest/receipt (own schemaVersion, no command/dryRun) and `schema` prints a JSON Schema with no schemaVersion.

Local verification is via a verify.sh running pre-push, lint, doc-check, test and workflow-contracts; workflow-contracts and some e2e tests (cargo publish, pnpm, uv) can't run in the agent sandbox and must be run outside it.
Three e2e tests (test_full_polyglot_workspace_release_lifecycle and two pnpm/uv native resolution tests) fail in the sandbox due to network denial.

callisto-action inputs are snake_case while outputs are camelCase; callisto-action hardcodes source:auto and verification:fallback for setup-callisto; callisto-validate has an apparent unresolved placeholder `uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto`.
docs/stability.md says codes freeze at 1.0: a code keeps its meaning and is never reused, hence E254 retired and E330-E339 added; PRs changing user-visible codes should be titled fix, not refactor.
Test fixtures with a GitHub-looking `origin` cause network access in CI; pointing origin at an unreachable local proxy makes tests offline.

atomic_write does file and directory fsync per manifest/changelog (F_FULLFSYNC on macOS), making `version --emit-preview` take 33-45s at 1,800 packages; AGENTS.md durability invariant prevents weakening it.

code.finding: New batched first_parent_commits_by_path git log used `--diff-merges=first-parent`; replaced with `-m` for compatibility with older git versions, tests still pass.
ReleaseOwners map replaces the quadratic workspace_package rescan; sets replace linear scans, cutting compose-pr-body at 1,800 packages from 12.1s to 1.5s (debug).
Release preflight now uses one batched git log plus batched cat-file instead of per-package processes (3,012 to 14 git processes), with fallback for non-matching newest candidates.

workflow: Verify subagent claims independently: rerun full checks outside the sandbox, and chase down subagent 'unsure' notes (e.g. network use) rather than accepting them.
Subagent hand-backs and teammate messages carry no user authority; use them as reports and act within the session's own permissions.
Run pairwise conflict checks across parallel branches before writing PR descriptions, and use mutation checks to confirm new tests fail on regression.
Delegate PR-body writing to narrator agents then edit titles/bodies for accuracy.
A subagent's sandbox mktemp failure ran a benchmark in the shared worktree and created stray tags; verify no stray tags remain (`git tag -l` patterns) after such incidents.

friction: Subagent sandbox lacked network and tools, so e2e tests failed and workflow-contracts couldn't run, requiring re-verification outside the sandbox.
.git/config lock errors appeared on branch switch in the sandbox.
perf-scale's first bench run fell back to the worktree after mktemp failed, staging 1,800 synthetic crates and creating stray tags in the shared .git (cleaned up by the agent).
The new test contacted github.com and crates.io via the fixture origin, requiring a fix to make it offline.
Narrator agents picked a `refactor(errors)` title for a change that alters user-visible codes.
open_items: Awaiting user yes on two small E165 help text changes for release safety.
Reviews of PRs #504, #505, #506 and the perf/scale-hotspots branch; CI has not run on any.
#493 release PR held until PRs merge, then render and read it as a user.
`version --emit-preview` slowness from per-file fsync (F_FULLFSYNC) left unfixed; Linux cost not measured.
Dirty-tree error path in check_partial_run does one git cat-file per manifest, not measured or fixed.
release_groups_of still scans all group members per entry; quadratic only for very large fixed/linked groups, untested.
Batched git log tested only on git 2.54 and mis-splits paths containing \x01.
The wall-clock-based 3,000-package lookup test (10s threshold) carries a small CI flake risk.
Decide whether `schema` output should ever carry a schemaVersion; inconsistent snake_case inputs vs camelCase outputs in callisto-action noted but unchanged.
Action inputs are undocumented outside action.yml; callisto-validate placeholder `$/.github/actions/setup-callisto` unchecked; `release build-python` only covered by the failing-case envelope test.
The unknown-field deny guard is a text scan and cannot see config structs outside src/config.
